description: Android: whether a Play install referrer without a click2 link is reported as a campaign install (its UTM tags / Google Ads click ids). Organic Play installs (utm_source=google-play, utm_medium=organic, or google-play with no other campaign keys) and click2 referrers whose link isn't on the configured hosts are not reported. Keys are matched case-insensitively and need a value; a referrer still URL-encoded once is decoded first.

cases.why: no campaign keys beyond the Play Store's own
Google Ads click id without UTM tags
a click2 link for another host
a click2 referrer without a usable link
